title: trFlow: ultrafast all-atom protein conformational ensemble generation via conditional flow matching
authors: Chenxiao Xiang; Kailong Zhao; Zhenling Peng; Wenkai Wang; Jianyi Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文提出trFlow，利用条件流匹配生成全原子蛋白质构象系综，结合混合采样、解耦表示-生成架构和NMR系综微调，在恢复替代功能态和异质性上优于现有方法且速度更快，直接命中蛋白质构象生成这一核心计算问题。
abstract: Generating diverse, all-atom protein conformations remains challenging, especially for recovering alternative functional states and modeling conformational ensembles. We present trFlow, an ultrafast approach for generating all-atom conformations using geometry-guided flow matching. trFlow leverages three core innovations: (1) a hybrid single- and multi-step sampling scheme that balances accuracy and speed; (2) a decoupled representation-generation architecture that maximizes computational efficiency; and (3) fine-tuning on NMR ensembles to better capture conformational heterogeneity. Extensive benchmarking across dual-conformation proteins, NMR ensembles, and a CASP16 dynamic target shows that trFlow outperforms competing methods in recovering challenging states and reproducing experimental heterogeneity, while being an order of magnitude faster than existing all-atom approaches. These results establish trFlow as a practical and scalable framework for large-scale generation of all-atom conformational ensembles.
abstract_zh: 生成多样化的全原子蛋白质构象仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在恢复替代功能状态和建模构象系综方面。我们提出了trFlow，一种利用几何引导的流匹配生成全原子构象的超快方法。trFlow利用三项核心创新：（1）混合单步和多步采样方案，平衡精度与速度；（2）解耦的表示-生成架构，最大化计算效率；（3）在NMR系综上的微调，以更好地捕捉构象异质性。在双构象蛋白质、NMR系综和CASP16动态靶标上的广泛基准测试表明，trFlow在恢复挑战性状态和重现实验异质性方面优于竞争方法，同时比现有全原子方法快一个数量级。这些结果确立了trFlow作为大规模生成全原子构象系综的实用且可扩展框架。
